composition: Interpolated counter values lie in [-1,1]; equal positive weights preserve that interval.
Zero endpoint first/second derivatives join the lattice noise C2. Linear projection through the hypervector and affine paths preserve C2; tanh and exp are smooth.
The exact-real construction has the stated bounds. Floating evaluation introduces roundoff; tests use explicit tolerances.
Normalized projection directions and navigation bases are evaluated numerically. Numerical sensitivity rank is not a global rank certificate.
Seed collisions and counter periodicity are possible; this is not cryptographic randomness or proven dynamical chaos.
